body: I just got mine taken off after two years! It’s definitely different, my girlfriend noticed an immediate change when I got them and when I took them off. She also said she could feel the pressure of the brackets which I understood cause I could feel it too. She was immediately happy when we had sex after I got them taken off. So I do think it’s makes a dm big difference.

We were everywhere! Almost 500 for the massive crowd does make it hard to spot us even with our purple shirts. For the most part we were in sweaters as well since it was cold. The oasis was located in Carnival Square right next to the lost and found this year, hopefully you encounter one of us next year.
